Class SecurityPositionSeriesReport

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reports.SecurityPositionSeriesReport
@Component public class SecurityPositionSeriesReport extends Object
Supplies the security position chart: the holding phases of one security in the scope of the view the chart was opened from, and the value, invested capital, results, returns and drawdown of one phase.

The scope is a tenant, a portfolio or one security account; accounts outside it never enter. Only the transactions of the security are loaded. The replay runs once per security account with its own summary map, because one map across accounts would mix them in the order of the accounts and not in time. It runs in the currency of the security, so a missing historical exchange rate cannot abort it; SecurityPositionSeries converts into the main currency itself. Nothing is stored or cached.

  • Method Details

    • getSeries

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public SecurityPositionSeriesResult getSeries(Integer idTenant, Integer idSecuritycurrency, Integer idPortfolio, Integer idSecurityaccount, LocalDate phaseFrom, LocalDate today)
      Calculates the phases and the series of one phase.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - tenant of the request
      idSecuritycurrency - the security
      idPortfolio - portfolio of the scope, or null
      idSecurityaccount - security account of the scope, or null; at most one of the two may be set
      phaseFrom - first day of the requested phase, null for the newest
      today - the client's calendar day, resolved on the request thread
      Returns:
      the phases and the series
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if the portfolio, the account or the security does not belong to the tenant
      DataViolationException - if both scope parameters are set
